issue_request: FHIR-13671 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It reported that the fourth Profiling FHIR discriminator example referred to an extension code even though extensions have urls, nested extensions, and values; the approved resolution said to change the fourth and sixth examples from .code to .value and adjust the descriptions.
initial_application: The issue was partially applied by svn revision 12774, imported as git commit 97c173d438da599cc2711e382171d82e6dabb79c. That commit changed the fourth and sixth discriminator paths from .code to .value but left both Interpretation descriptions referring to code elements.
additional_context: source/profiling.html is in the current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml. The latest combined branch still had the corrected .value paths and stale code-element descriptions, and no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that would narrow or reverse the Jira decision.
reconciliation: Changed the fourth example description to refer to the value element in the extension and the sixth example description to refer to the value element of the referenced resource.
source_changes: source/profiling.html: updated the fourth and sixth discriminator example Interpretation text from code-element wording to value-element wording.
